description: This file implements the ProofVerifierChromium class and its nested Job class, responsible for verifying cryptographic proofs and certificate chains in the Chromium network stack, specifically for QUIC protocol security.

classes.name: ProofVerifyDetailsChromium
classes.description: Holds details of proof verification, including certificate verification results and SCTs.

classes.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job
classes.description: Handles the asynchronous verification of proofs and certificate chains for a single proof verification request.

methods.name: ProofVerifyDetailsChromium::Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the proof verify details.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::VerifyProof
methods.description: Starts proof verification; invokes callback asynchronously if pending.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Starts certificate chain verification; invokes callback asynchronously if pending.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::GetX509Certificate
methods.description: Converts DER-encoded certs to X509Certificate object.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::DoLoop
methods.description: Manages the verification state machine loop.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous IO operations.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::DoVerifyCertComplete
methods.description: Processes the result of certificate verification, including policy checks.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the signature on the server config using the certificate's public key.

methods.name: ProofVerifierChromium::Job::ShouldAllowUnknownRootForHost
methods.description: Determines if unknown roots are allowed for a hostname.
